name: b33_route_v2
what: Waypoints for b33_drive.ps1 (W2DEV), v2 PROPOSED from the DEV rehearsal survey 1 (NOT-PREREG) and the DEV kerb survey v2. DIAGNOSTIC tool input, not evidence; path design for the drive, not a measurement threshold. The official route is fixed only by the B-9 survey addendum on the candidate. Coordinates are the SENDER LOG frame (WLREMOTE send soles=(x,y,z)); yaw 0 = +x, 90 = +y.
